title: setup-python: uv Python catalog check must run after setup-uv and before the install steps
answers: CI fails because uv cannot provision the Python version in the fixture
uv python install fails on a runner platform with no download
where do I add a check that the requested Python version is downloadable by uv
why does the setup-python composite action validate the uv Python catalog
body:
Invariant: the "Check uv Python support" step in the composite action runs after `setup-uv` and after `get-python-version`, and before the uv-driven install steps.
Enforced by: .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml (step "Check uv Python support"), which reads `steps.get-python-version.outputs.version` and runs `uv python list "$PYTHON_VERSION" --all-versions --only-downloads`.
What it guards: the check queries the catalog on the actual runner platform, so an empty result means uv cannot download that Python here. It fails the job early with a `::error::` annotation instead of failing later during provisioning.
Skipping or reordering it: moving it before `setup-uv` makes `uv` unavailable; removing it lets CI fail late with an opaque provisioning error.
The check only validates; it does not download, pin versions, or enumerate platforms. If it fails, the error message directs the fix to `required-version` in pyproject.toml, so keep that message consistent with where the uv pin actually lives.
applies: Changes to the setup-python composite action or to how CI selects and provisions Python/uv versions in this repo.
says: Continuous integration build fails late with an unclear error when downloading the requested Python.
Validate that the target Python version is available before running the workflow installation steps.
Pull request checks fail with an opaque error instead of catching missing Python early.
The automated build error message should clearly point developers to the version configuration setting.
Automated test runner cannot provision the requested Python release on this operating system platform.

It reads `steps.get-python-version.outputs.version` and runs `uv python list "$PYTHON_VERSION" --all-versions --only-downloads` on the runner platform, failing early with an error annotation if the requested Python version cannot be downloaded. Applies to changes to the composite action or CI Python/uv provisioning, but only validates availability without downloading, pinning versions, or enumerating platforms. Moving it before `setup-uv` fails because `uv` is unavailable, and failure messages must point to `required-version` in `pyproject.toml`.
